subject: Hosted API integration architecture review — scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@maplehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API integration architecture review

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Maple Health is interested in a deeper architecture review focused on the Hosted API integration. We'd like to walk through SDK usage patterns, streaming and chunked responses, and how function/tool calling would look when integrated into our microservices.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive next week? Ideal attendees from our side: myself (product), Sophie Le (platform engineer), and one backend engineer. We prefer mornings PST.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Product Manager
Maple Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review

Hi Liam — great to hear. I'm looping in Maya (AM) and Diego (Solutions Engineer) who will run the session.

A few proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue 2026-03-02, 09:00–10:15
- Tue 2026-03-02, 11:00–12:15
- Wed 2026-03-03, 09:30–10:45

Proposed agenda (high-level):
1) 10 min intros + goals
2) 25–30 min architecture walkthrough (SDKs, request/response lifecycle, streaming)
3) 20 min demo of function/tool calling patterns + error handling
4) 10–15 min Q&A and integration next steps

Attaching a short quickstart and an example integration snippet (redwood-hosted-api-quickstart.pdf). Also sharing a checklist of things to have ready on your side: service auth keys, current request patterns, and a sample prompt set if possible.

If the 11:00 slot works for you we can send a calendar invite. What timezone is Sophie in?

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Le <sophie.le@maplehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@maplehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration architecture review

Thanks Jordan — Sophie here. 11:00 PST works better for us than 09:00. Could we push the start by 15 minutes to make room for our morning standups (11:15–12:30 PST)? Also can you include a short agenda item on how streaming interacts with our async job queue — we use Celery-style async workers.

Also we'll need a recording and a Zoom link (we have restrictions on external meeting platforms).

Cheers,
Sophie Le
Platform Engineer
Maple Health

Subject: Hosted API Architecture Review — calendar invite and agenda

Hi Liam and Sophie — thanks. Locked in: Tue 2026-03-02, 11:15–12:30 PST (75 minutes). Sending a Google Calendar invite now.

Draft agenda (updated):
- 11:15–11:25: intros & integration goals (Jordan + Maple)
- 11:25–11:55: SDK patterns, request lifecycle, and streaming semantics (Diego)
- 11:55–12:15: function/tool calling and recommended error/retry strategies (Diego + Maya)
- 12:15–12:30: security/residency & next steps (Priya)

Zoom link (Maple preference accepted): Zoom will be provided from Maple's side; if you prefer Redwood-hosted link let us know. Recording: agreed.

Shared materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dEFgh (contains the quickstart and the current arch diagram). I'm also attaching the latest architecture diagram (arch-diagram-v2.png).

Calendar stub: Google Calendar: Hosted API Architecture Review — Tue Mar 2, 2026 — 11:15 AM PST — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Action items before the call:
- Maple: add a short sample of your streaming request pattern and an example of the async job flow (Celery)
- Redwood: send a brief one-page mapping that shows how function calling maps to your current SDK and a sample streaming client snippet

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan

Redwood Inference

All good — 11:15 PST on Tue works for us and we'll share the sample async job flow and a short snippet of our streaming request before the call (aiming to upload to the shared Drive by EOD today).

One quick ask: Sophie will be dialing in from a hospital network that restricts outbound connections; can we please confirm that no outbound ports beyond standard HTTPS (443) are required for the streaming client? If there are websockets we may need to have IT open them in advance.

Appreciate the agenda and attachments. See you Tuesday — we'll upload the artifacts to the Drive link.

Thanks,
Liam
